title: Graded DCA run-classification policy document
description: Shape of config/run_classification.json, the human/machine policy that governs how scheduled live runs of the repaired live task 10ce362c (which supersedes the deleted ce16ba6b) are distinguished from manual runs. This is the POLICY document; the run_classification block embedded in each run_state artifact is validated by run_classification.schema.json instead. Contains no secrets.

policy_id.description: Stable id of this policy, e.g. 'run-classification-v1'.

version.description: Snapshot date/version of the policy document.

state_schema_version.description: Version tag shared with the embedded run_classification block; pinned to 'run-classification-v1'.
